studio._comment: Official built-in Studio MCP. Enable: Studio → Assistant → Settings → MCP Servers. Route ONLY playtest/input/screenshot — its mesh/texture generation is low quality; use rbx3d/blender/mixar instead.

rbx3d._comment: Blender-backed Roblox asset toolkit — THE mesh/animation pipeline. Generate/build Roblox-ready models + animations in Blender (1 unit = 1 stud, R15 rigs, ≤20k tris), export, then rbx_import_mesh / rbx_mesh_watch into Studio.

blender._comment: General Blender control (execute_bpy_script, look, generate_3d). For custom modeling, materials, retopo, texture work before Roblox export.

mixar._comment: AI text/image→3D generation with scene tabs (enqueue_generation — costs credits). Use when a prompt-generated base mesh beats hand-building, then validate+export to Studio.

generation_policy: Mesh/texture/animation generation routes to rbx3d/blender/mixar upstreams — NEVER studio.generate_mesh/generate_texture (low quality). Official upstream is only for: start_stop_play, user_keyboard/mouse_input, character_navigation, screen_capture, get_console_output.
